question: How independently controlled is the historical-modern k~g relationship relevant to color -cameke/-gameke and modern -ka/-ga-me?

historical_series.source: Steffel as analyzed by Merrill et al. 2020
historical_series.value: Direct c/k/g variation in one lexical item; c and k represent [k], while g represents a distinct voiced velar segment in Merrill's reconstruction.
Initial g~k alternation outside color morphology.
Medial g~k alternation outside color morphology.

historical_series.source: Steffel grammar as analyzed by Merrill et al. 2020
historical_series.value: k~g alternation participates in a grammatical plural/reduplication process.

historical_depth.finding: Merrill states that both Guadalaxara and Steffel document [k~g], and considers it likely to reflect changes predating the seventeenth century involving voiced segments derived historically from voiceless stops.
historical_depth.caution: The historical language also has k/g minimal contrasts, so alternation is not universal or automatic.

modern_multivariety_series.source: Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997
modern_multivariety_series.value: Modern lexical g~k variation is directly reported in one regional set.

modern_multivariety_series.source: Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997
modern_multivariety_series.value: The pre-participial slot of the same gray-color construction is realized with -ga- in one variety and -ka- in another.

modern_multivariety_series.source: Compendio básico de la gramática ralámuli 1997
modern_multivariety_series.value: The multivariety description groups k/g/cha forms in the same functional color-modifier domain.

modern_negative_control.finding: The Choguita phonemic inventory contains /k/ but no /g/ phoneme.
modern_negative_control.interpretation: A k~g relation cannot be treated as a pan-Rarámuri synchronic rule; it is historical/dialectal and its reflexes must be modeled variety by variety.

assessment.reason: The color comparison is no longer the only environment where g/k correspond. Historical same-lexeme pairs and a modern same-slot gray-color pair independently control the relation, while Choguita supplies a negative control against universalization.

impact_on_color_hypothesis.constraint: Model the retained stative/participial architecture as dialectally realized and potentially analogically remodeled, not as a single invariant *ga>ka rule.
